episode_profile.title: AI and Machine Learning Research in Iraq
episode_profile.guest_title: Machine Learning Engineer and PhD Student
episode_profile.topic_summary: Almammon discusses the state of AI and machine learning research in Iraq, focusing on his work in violence detection using deep learning. He highlights the challenges faced by researchers in Iraq, including limited resources and outdated educational materials.

key_arguments.claim: The lack of infrastructure and resources severely limits AI research in Iraq.
key_arguments.speaker: Almammon Rasool Abdali
key_arguments.context: Almammon explains that many universities lack the necessary labs and computing power to conduct advanced AI research.

key_arguments.claim: AI education in Iraq is outdated, focusing on classical methods rather than modern techniques.
key_arguments.speaker: Almammon Rasool Abdali
key_arguments.context: He notes that many students are not exposed to current AI methodologies, which hampers their ability to innovate.

key_arguments.claim: Companies like Google and AWS are providing essential support for AI research through cloud credits.
key_arguments.speaker: Almammon Rasool Abdali
key_arguments.context: Almammon discusses how he utilizes cloud resources to conduct his research, which would otherwise be impossible due to local limitations.

key_arguments.claim: His violence detection model achieved a 96.25% accuracy, surpassing previous benchmarks.
key_arguments.speaker: Almammon Rasool Abdali
key_arguments.context: He highlights the significance of his research in addressing real-world issues in Iraq, particularly in public safety.

key_arguments.claim: There is a growing interest in AI among students in Iraq, despite the challenges.
key_arguments.speaker: Almammon Rasool Abdali
key_arguments.context: He mentions that he has a community of 4,000 student researchers who are eager to learn and engage with AI.

key_arguments.claim: Collaboration between universities and industry is essential for advancing AI research in Iraq.
key_arguments.speaker: Almammon Rasool Abdali
key_arguments.context: He argues that partnerships with companies could provide valuable data and resources for research.
